meta.name: game-gdd-author
meta.description: Invoke for guided game design document authoring -- section-by-section GDD creation with validation, pillar alignment, and scope tier marking. Triggers on: "write GDD", "create GDD", "game design document", "document my game", "GDD authoring", "fill in GDD". Do NOT invoke for reviewing an existing GDD (use game-design-review) or designing specific game systems (use game-designer). Part of the AlterLab GameForge collection.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按章节创建游戏设计文档，验证核心支柱并标记范围
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要结构化撰写游戏设计文档并确保设计一致性
copy.tagline_en: Create game design documents section by section with validation and scope marking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to author structured game design documents with consistency checks

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会引导你一步步填写游戏设计文档（GDD），每写一个部分都会提问、检查矛盾，并确保每个功能都对应你设定的设计支柱和范围等级。
howto.when: 当你说出“写 GDD”、“创建 GDD”、“游戏设计文档”、“记录我的游戏”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个动作RPG的游戏设计文档。
say.note: Claude 会从电梯演讲和设计支柱开始引导你。

say.text: 我想把我的游戏概念整理成GDD。
say.note: Claude 会按10个部分逐步引导你填写。

say.text: 帮我填写GDD的核心循环部分。
say.note: Claude 会先问你关于玩家30秒内操作的问题。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude guides you step-by-step through writing a Game Design Document (GDD), asking questions, flagging contradictions, and ensuring every feature aligns with your design pillars and scope tier.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "write GDD", "create GDD", "game design document", "document my game", or similar phrases.

say_en.text: Help me write a GDD for an action RPG.
say_en.note: Claude will start with the elevator pitch and pillars.

say_en.text: I want to formalize my game concept into a GDD.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through 10 sections step by step.

say_en.text: Fill in the core loop section of my GDD.
say_en.note: Claude will first ask about the player's first 30 seconds.
